title: CartItemPriceAdjustment - Data API
description: Price adjustment for a cart item. This object is available in API version 52.0 and later.

AdjustmentAmountScope.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
AdjustmentAmountScope.description: Scope of the adjustment amount for a promotion. Possible values are: Total—The amount off the total price. This field is available in API version 54.0 and later.

AdjustmentBasisReferenceId.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
AdjustmentBasisReferenceId.description: Coupon code of the coupon associated with a promotion. This field is available in API version 54.0 and later. This is a relationship field.

AdjustmentSource.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
AdjustmentSource.description: Price adjustment type. Possible values are: Discretionary Promotion System

AdjustmentTargetType.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
AdjustmentTargetType.description: Target for the price adjustment (the cart itself or individual items). Possible values are: Cart Item

AdjustmentType.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
AdjustmentType.description: Indicates if the price adjustment is applied as percentage or an absolute amount. Possible values are: AdjustmentAmount AdjustmentPercentage

AdjustmentValue.description: Numeric value of the adjustment (for example, 10 if the price adjustment is either 10% off or $10 off).

CartId.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
CartId.description: The ID of the WebCart that’s associated with a cart item. This field is available in API version 55.0 and later. This is a relationship field.

CartItemId.description: ID of the parent cart item to which this adjustment belongs. This is a relationship field.

CurrencyIsoCode.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
CurrencyIsoCode.description: The ISO code for the currency that’s specified on the buyer’s account. Default value is USD. Possible values are: EUR—Euro USD—U.S. Dollar

Name.properties: Create, Filter, Group, idLookup, Sort, Update

PriceAdjustmentCauseId.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Sort, Nillable, Update
PriceAdjustmentCauseId.description: ID of entity that caused this adjustment (for example, a promotion ID). If unspecified, then Description populates the display name. This is a relationship field.

Priority.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
Priority.description: If there are multiple price adjustments, sequence in which the price adjustments are applied.

TotalAmount.description: Total price after applying price adjustments.

TotalGrossAmount.description: The total gross amount (tax inclusive) after applying price adjustments. This field is available in API version 55.0 and later.

TotalNetAmount.description: The total net amount (tax exclusive) after applying price adjustments. This field is available in API version 55.0 and later.

TotalTax.description: Tax on the total adjusted price.

WebCartAdjustmentGroupId.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
WebCartAdjustmentGroupId.description: ID of the cart’s adjustment group. This is a relationship field.

special_access_rules: The CartItemPriceAdjustment object is available only if the B2B Commerce or D2C Commerce license is enabled.
associated_objects:
This object has the following associated objects. Unless it’s noted, associated objects are available in the same API version as this object.

- **CartItemPriceAdjustmentChangeEvent (API version 58.0)**: Change events are available for the object.
